Docs API

Peer database

A client keeps a local database of the peers it has seen, so that it can turn an identifier into a request without asking the server again.

Constructors

  • inputPeerEmpty
  • inputPeerSelf
  • inputPeerChat
  • inputPeerUser
  • inputPeerChannel

Access hashes

Each identifier is paired with an access hash. The pair is only valid for the session that obtained it, which is why a client caches both together.
